'''Lorrd II''' was the largest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]], which was located in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
During the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] established a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] colony on Lorrd II. The colony was raided by a group of [[Revanchist]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the latter stages of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. They freed the slaves and looted a number of [[Lorrdian gemstone/Legends|Lorrdian gemstones]], a type of crystal that could be used in the construction of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
